title: JA Nova wp7 1.1.7: forms, focus, drawer, share column and page spacing behave like the source (all ten sweep checks), and the 1.1.5/1.1.6 browser checks still pass
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-nova theme under test (local stand from the quickstart pack, or its clean restore) and the Joomla source (local stand installed from the quickstart/ja-nova/j6 installer zip 1.0.4, web fonts loading).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/scripts/visual/site-sweep.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --run-root tasks/ja-nova-wp7 --zip <theme.zip> --baseline <sweep output of the previous version, all ten checks> --baseline-version <version> --out <dir> (no --only: the default is all ten checks; about 7 minutes).

S3: Then run the earlier browser checks: node tasks/ja-nova-wp7/tools/measure115.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --out <dir>/m115 --wp "<wp-cli command prefix of the site>" --mode after (about 5 minutes), and node tasks/ja-nova-wp7/tools/sweep-extra.mjs --site <site> --sweep <dir> --out <dir>/extra.json.
S4: Read the check list at the end of S2, the PASS/FAIL lines of S3 and the last two lines of the sweep-extra output.
expect: site-sweep: exit 0, all ten checks pass (overflow, scheme, background, header, chips, fixed-widgets, icons, forms, text, first-interaction) with 0 defects and nothing left unmeasured; the previous version passes 6/10 (fixed-widgets: article share column; forms: search field required and focus look; first-interaction: drawer dim).
sweep-extra: 'auto = chosen' 0 defect groups over 30 routes; 'chips by order' 0 unmeasured and 0 defect rows.
evidence: Sweeps of 05/10/2026 against the local Joomla source stand: 1.1.6 fails 4 of 10 checks (article share column sticky, search field required, field focus look, drawer dim), 1.1.7 passes 10/10 on the clean restore (bound to wp-ja-nova-1.1.7.zip 3a825d39; tasks/ja-nova-wp7/release/fix-measure.json); measure115 11/11 on the restore (tasks/ja-nova-wp7/release/BROWSER.json)
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the tool fails closed on a crash, a deadline or a case it cannot measure
